prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop university landing-page UI comp for Instituto Tecnológico de San Miguel, edge to edge in a landscape viewport, crisp readable Spanish text, no browser frame or device. This is a fictional educational portfolio institution; label it discreetly 'Institución ficticia · Proyecto de portafolio'. Visitors explore two programs: Desarrollo de Software and Redes y Telecomunicaciones. Lead with an atlas-of-possibilities concept: one expansive photographic campus panorama carries an integrated program index with a clear selected state, descriptive program detail and 'Explorar programa' action. It must read as an inviting working university website with actual navigation and program selection, never a decorative geographic map. The panorama and the type form one confident architectural composition rather than a conventional split hero or headline-plus-card row. Include the first viewport and the beginning of the Sobre nosotros section to demonstrate continuity. The full institutional name, navigation 'Instituto', 'Programas', 'Historia', 'Contacto', direct 'Estudiantes' and 'Docentes' access, ES/EN and theme controls are legible parts of the frame. The visual world draws on campus orientation atlases, using luminous emerald #48B292 as a large visual field, cool near-white ground and deep green text. Humanist sans typography has strong scale contrast and precise indexed wayfinding. Show a sunlit contemporary planted campus as illustrative photography. A small 'Pausar movimiento' control indicates the future gentle photo motion. No invented prices, claims, accreditation, statistics or testimonials.
